title: Sail the north coast in a Menorcan llaüt
description: The llaüt is the traditional boat of these islands: wood, a slow engine and room for very few. Leaving Fornells in one and tracing the north coast — Cavalleria, Binimel·là, the red coves no road reaches — is the calmest way to see Menorca from the water. Small groups, book ahead, and departures depend on the sea.
imageAlt: Fornells bay with yachts at anchor and the white village behind
